<a id="what-a-learner-can-learn-through-its-registration--经其识所能学者"></a>
# What a learner can learn through its registration

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`learnable-through-registration` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F11 · [record](learnable-through-registration.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Configurations with the same registered future give every learner the same record. In a world a list holds, some learner rests on a target everywhere exactly where such configurations have targets agreeing from some step on; under a still law, exactly where it goes alike across the registration.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A learner claims a target from the registered record: the registered course of a configuration's orbit (course); claiming the target at every step from T on is resting from T (RestsFrom), and resting is resting from some T (Rests). (`Becoming.Learnable.course`, `Becoming.Learnable.RestsFrom`, `Becoming.Learnable.Rests`)
2. Two configurations with the same registered future give every learner the same record at every step; so at a step where their targets differ a claim is right on at most one, with no decision, and with the target values decided a claim is refuted on one while the two records stay equal at every step. (`Becoming.Learnable.records_same`, `Becoming.Learnable.claim_not_right_on_both`, `Becoming.Learnable.refuted_on_one`)
3. A learner resting on both has targets agreeing from some step on; so where they differ at arbitrarily late steps no learner rests on both, already where the law leaves both configurations unchanged, the registration does not tell them apart and their targets differ. (`Becoming.Learnable.agree_of_rests_both`, `Becoming.Learnable.not_rests_on_both`, `Becoming.Learnable.orbit_of_still`, `Becoming.Learnable.still_not_rests_on_both`)
4. Where the target is read off what is registered, the learner over the lasso hypotheses on the registered values, its claims read off, rests on the target in every world a list holds from the identification bound on; it is given neither the configurations, nor how many there are, nor any value of the target. (`Becoming.Learnable.rests_through`)
5. Exactly: in a world a list holds, some learner reading the registration rests at every configuration exactly where configurations with the same registered future have targets agreeing from some step on; the necessary side holds of every learner, and the learner of the sufficient side is given the world and the target. (`Becoming.Learnable.learnable_iff`, `Becoming.Learnable.withWorld`, `Becoming.Learnable.withWorldAt`, `Becoming.Learnable.firstFit_congr`)
6. Targets going alike across the registration are learnable; under a law leaving every configuration unchanged, exactly those are. (`Becoming.Learnable.learnable_of_lumped`, `Becoming.Learnable.still_lumped_of_rests`, `Becoming.Learnable.still_learnable_iff_lumped`)
7. Two coordinates under a still law: registering the first, no learner rests on the second at both (true, false) and (true, true), the second not going alike across the first; registering both, the lasso learner rests from step 2. (`Becoming.Learnable.Pair.still`, `Becoming.Learnable.Pair.stays`, `Becoming.Learnable.Pair.first_not_rests`, `Becoming.Learnable.Pair.not_lumped`, `Becoming.Learnable.Pair.whole_rests`)
8. Along runs: a determined law's run gives a learner its orbit's record, so the learner rests on the run exactly where it rests on that orbit; runs beginning alike in the registration's frame give every learner one record; where a list holds the world, a target is learnable along every run exactly where such runs have targets agreeing from some step on, under a still law where it goes alike across the registration. (`Becoming.LearnableRuns.course`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.RestsFrom`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.Rests`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.record_eq`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.restsFrom_iff`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.rests_iff`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.course_same`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.records_same`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.agree_of_rests_both`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.not_rests_on_both`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.rests_through`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.learnable_iff`, `Becoming.LearnableRuns.still_learnable_iff_lumped`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Decidable equality of registered values (DecidableEq R) appears only as a condition of the lasso learner and of withWorld, in the statement of rests_through and the proof of learnable_iff; decidable equality of target values (DecidableEq V) only in refuted_on_one.
- Each theorem's conditions are written into it: the same registered future; targets differing at arbitrarily late steps; the orbit or the world held by a list; the target read off the registration (val s = g (reg s)); the law leaving configurations unchanged.
- In learnable_iff and its corollaries the configurations live in Type (the type of Identification.firstFit); the other theorems hold in every universe.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The learner of the sufficient side is given the world and the target; a learner given nothing is shown only for targets read off the present registration. Witness: `Becoming.Learnable.rests_through`.
- Under a general law, learnable does not imply going alike across the registration: a target reading the next registered value is learnable without it.
- The condition is on pairs of configurations, not on each; reading it off needs the world.
- The learner still tells registered values apart; learning where the registered values themselves are not told apart is not stated.
- No correspondence to human learning, neural networks, attention or perceptual thresholds is checked.
- **Counterexample:** Pair: registering the first coordinate, no learner rests on the second at both (true, false) and (true, true) (Pair.first_not_rests). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Learnable.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow Ren's naming criteria of 10 October 2026 and are adopted where the statement has their exact meaning (Ren, 12 October 2026); readings not marked as Ren's are decided by the AI on Ren's delegation of 15 October 2026, which Ren can reverse.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren, 12 October 2026: “please, fully complete, 我觉得理更像是对结构和变化的规律的建模 finish wisdom root, and resolve the undissolved”. Learning by refutation left learning where registration does not tell values apart unstated. This result states it: what a learner can learn through a registration is exactly where configurations with the same registered future agree from some step on. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): registration bounds what is learned; on Ren's reading 理 is the modeling of the laws of structure and of change, and that modeling is learned through registration as it is tested through it; a difference below threshold (a condition depended on and not observed registers only whether it meets the need) is learnable only where it shows in the registered future or vanishes from the target; what lies beyond registration is reached only by widening it: new observation, another's registration.

- **formal-reuse**: [identification-where-bounded](identification-where-bounded.md). Reuses held_learner_rests (the step at which the learner not given the bound rests), Law.name, Law.sameFuture_iff_below, record_eq_iff, firstFit, firstFit_sound and firstFit_found.
  - Output: A bounded record fixes the registered future; the step at which the learner not given the bound rests.
  - Input: A target read off the registration learned within the bound; the learner given the world.
  - Preserved conditions: The world or the orbit held by a list. [Identification.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Identification.lean)

- **formal-reuse**: [seeking-boundary](seeking-boundary.md). Reuses Law.fixed_rests: a configuration the law leaves unchanged is its own orbit.
  - Output: A still configuration stays.
  - Input: Two still configurations.
  - Preserved conditions: The law leaving the configuration unchanged. [Seeking.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Seeking.lean)

  - Output: Orbits.

- related, not a proved adapter: [generalization-through-lumping](generalization-through-lumping.md). Under a still law, the learnable targets are exactly those going alike across the registration; the lumping generalization goes through is the one the registration gives.
- related, not a proved adapter: [subthreshold-registration](subthreshold-registration.md). A condition depended on and not observed registers only as a threshold; read for learners, a difference below threshold is learnable only where it shows in the registered future or vanishes from the target (a reading).
- related, not a proved adapter: [wisdom-root-part-one](wisdom-root-part-one.md). Its learning clause read through registration: a learner learns no more than the registered future tells apart.
